# tailwind v0.5.1 - Table of Contents

> Mix tasks for installing and invoking tailwind

## Pages

- [CHANGELOG](https://tailwind.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Tailwind](https://tailwind.hexdocs.pm/Tailwind.md): Tailwind is an installer and runner for [tailwind](https://tailwindcss.com/).

## Mix Tasks

- [mix tailwind](https://tailwind.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Tailwind.md): Invokes tailwind with the given args.
- [mix tailwind.install](https://tailwind.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Tailwind.Install.md): Installs Tailwind executable and assets.
